common.missing: This workshop does not exist (any more).
common.login: Your sign-in has expired, so changes cannot be saved. Sign in again; nothing you saved before is lost.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.emptyBody: Create the first one and start planning.

planner.parkingHint: Not part of the agenda. Drag items here to keep them for later, and back when you need them.
planner.deleteDayConfirm: Delete this day? Its items move to the parking lot.
planner.live: Live: changes from other windows appear here
planner.emptyDay: Add items or drag them here
planner.syncError: A change could not be saved. The workshop was reloaded from the server.
planner.keys: Click an item for details, its title, time or length to edit it there · drag to move · Shift+click to select several · Ctrl+Z undo
planner.moveOtherDays_one: Move the other day by the same number of days?
planner.moveOtherDays_other: Move the {{count}} other days by the same number of days?

workshop.title: Title
workshop.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” with all days, items and files? This cannot be undone.
workshop.duplicateHint: Copies days, groups, items, material and files. The packing list starts unticked.

packing.empty: No material yet. Add material to the agenda items.

files.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? It is unlinked from all items.

settings.daysHint: Start and target end of new workshops and added days.
settings.categoriesHint: Kinds of steps with a quiet colour; set them per item, override the colour where needed.
settings.logoHint: Shown at the top of every printout. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB.
settings.logoTooLarge: The logo is larger than 2 MB.
settings.logoFailed: The logo could not be uploaded (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG).
settings.agentsHint: Agents such as Claude connect through OAuth and can then read and change your workshops: agendas, notes, material, packing lists and the library. Disconnecting one stops its access at once.
settings.agentsOff: Not enabled on the server. Set SP_MCP_OAUTH=1 (see docs/mcp.md) to let Claude connect.
settings.agentsDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{name}}? It loses access immediately and has to be approved again.
settings.agentsError: Could not load or change the connections ({{error}}). Try again; until then they stay as they were.

toolbox.resize: Drag to resize · double-click to reset

library.subtitle: Items and groups to reuse in any workshop. Inserting one makes a copy.
library.emptyHint: Save an item (details) or a group (its ⋯ menu) to the library, then drag it into any workshop.
library.dragHint: Drag into the agenda, or + to park.
library.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” from the library? Workshops keep their copies.

guest.nothingSharedBody: As soon as a workshop is shared with {{email}}, it appears here.

access.title: Access
access.hint: Guests sign in with their own Microsoft account. They need a guest account in your Entra and must be let in at the Session Planner's login (see the guide).
access.invalid: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
access.notListed: This address is not on the Session Planner's login list yet: the person can only sign in once it is added (apps-server README, section 7).

time.flowsHint: Starts at {{time}}, right after the item before.
